WITH date_range AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT d_date_sk, d_date
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_month_seq BETWEEN 1212 AND 1212 + 11
),
web_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_item_sk AS item_sk,
        dr.d_date,
        SUM(SUM(ws.ws_sales_price)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ws.ws_item_sk
            ORDER BY dr.d_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cume_sales
    FROM web_sales ws
    JOIN date_range dr ON ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE ws.ws_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ws.ws_item_sk, dr.d_date
),
store_v1 AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        ss.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
        dr.d_date,
        SUM(SUM(ss.ss_sales_price)) OVER (
            PARTITION BY ss.ss_item_sk
            ORDER BY dr.d_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cume_sales
    FROM store_sales ss
    JOIN date_range dr ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dr.d_date_sk
    WHERE ss.ss_item_sk IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ss.ss_item_sk, dr.d_date
)
SELECT *
FROM (
    SELECT
        item_sk,
        d_date,
        web_sales,
        store_sales,
        MAX(web_sales) OVER (
            PARTITION BY item_sk
            ORDER BY d_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS web_cumulative,
        MAX(store_sales) OVER (
            PARTITION BY item_sk
            ORDER BY d_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS store_cumulative
    FROM (
        SELECT
            web.item_sk,
            web.d_date,
            web.cume_sales AS web_sales,
            store.cume_sales AS store_sales
        FROM web_v1 web
        LEFT JOIN store_v1 store
            ON web.item_sk = store.item_sk AND web.d_date = store.d_date
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            store.item_sk,
            store.d_date,
            web.cume_sales AS web_sales,
            store.cume_sales AS store_sales
        FROM store_v1 store
        LEFT JOIN web_v1 web
            ON store.item_sk = web.item_sk AND store.d_date = web.d_date
        WHERE web.item_sk IS NULL
    ) AS combined
) AS y
WHERE web_cumulative > store_cumulative
ORDER BY item_sk, d_date
LIMIT 100
